name: habitus-habit-tracker
description: Professional monochrome habit tracker, daily timetable ledger, and monthly performance reports.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public', {recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('public/icons', {recursive:true}); ['index.html','style.css','app.js','manifest.json','sw.js'].forEach(f => { if (fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'public/'+f); }); if (fs.existsSync('icons/icon.svg')) fs.copyFileSync('icons/icon.svg', 'public/icons/icon.svg'); console.log('Build complete: PWA and public assets populated');"

author: Habitus Team
